chapter: Kline 1980: early years and founding of the Goldkette orchestra
title: Teaching himself drums and the Versatile Five
summary: He taught himself drums around age 12, played in school groups, and after high school toured with the Versatile Five of Chambersburg.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Okay. So when you were a child, did you take lessons or what?
No, I just came in and sat down.
And started playing all by yourself without any lessons?
Yeah.
And what were you playing then, the drums?
The drums, yeah.
Uh huh. And how old were you when you started playing drums?
Oh I must have been 12.
And you were playing that in school I guess.
Yeah.
School groups
Yeah.
When did you first play with a group of other musicians. Was it in high school or after high school?
No, it was after high school.
Tell me about that. Who were you playing with? Where was that?
That was in Chambersburg. Pennsylvania.
Uh huh. Was that the Versatile Five? Is that the group you had?
Yeah, the Verstatile Five, yeah.
All right, the Versatile Five. And
after this, did you graduate from high school or did you leave high school?
No, I graduated.
And then what did you do? You went on the road with the group?
Then I went on the road with the group, yeah.
